description: C Programming basic concepts and fundamentals practice set for Bihar STET.

questions.questionText: Who is known as the creator of the C programming language?
questions.explanation: Dennis Ritchie developed the C programming language at Bell Labs.

questions.questionText: Which function is the entry point of a C program?
questions.explanation: Execution of a C program begins from the main() function.

questions.questionText: Which header file is required for printf() and scanf()?
questions.explanation: printf() and scanf() are declared in the stdio.h header file.

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to terminate a statement in C?
questions.explanation: A semicolon (;) is used to terminate most statements in C.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid variable name in C?
questions.explanation: A C identifier can contain letters, digits and underscores but cannot begin with a digit or contain spaces or hyphens.

questions.questionText: Which data type is used to store a single character in C?
questions.explanation: The char data type is used to store a single character.

questions.questionText: Which format specifier is commonly used to print an integer value in C?
questions.explanation: %d is commonly used with printf() to print an integer value.

questions.questionText: Which format specifier is used to read a character using scanf()?
questions.explanation: %c is used to read a character using scanf().

questions.questionText: Which operator is used for addition in C?
questions.explanation: The + operator performs addition in C.

questions.questionText: Which operator gives the remainder after integer division?
questions.explanation: The modulus operator (%) returns the remainder of integer division.

questions.questionText: Which operator is used to assign a value to a variable?
questions.explanation: The assignment operator (=) assigns a value to a variable.

questions.questionText: Which operator is used to compare two values for equality?
questions.explanation: The equality operator (==) checks whether two values are equal.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to declare an integer variable in C?
questions.explanation: The keyword int is used to declare an integer variable.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to declare a constant variable in C?
questions.explanation: The const keyword is used to declare an object whose value should not be modified through that identifier.

questions.questionText: Which statement is used to make a decision based on a condition?
questions.explanation: The if statement executes a block when its condition is true.

questions.questionText: Which loop is generally used when the number of iterations is known in advance?
questions.explanation: The for loop is commonly used when initialization, condition and update can be specified together.

questions.questionText: Which loop executes its body at least once?
questions.explanation: In a do-while loop, the condition is checked after the loop body, so the body executes at least once.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to exit from a loop immediately?
questions.explanation: The break statement terminates the nearest enclosing loop or switch statement.

questions.questionText: Which keyword skips the remaining statements of the current loop iteration?
questions.explanation: The continue statement skips the remaining part of the current iteration and proceeds to the next iteration.

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to start a single-line comment in C?
questions.explanation: A double slash (//) starts a single-line comment in C.

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to start a multi-line comment in C?
questions.explanation: A multi-line comment begins with /* and ends with */.

questions.questionText: What is the index of the first element of an array in C?
questions.explanation: C arrays use zero-based indexing, so the first element has index 0.

questions.questionText: Which declaration creates an integer array capable of storing 5 elements?
questions.explanation: int arr[5]; declares an array of 5 integers.

questions.questionText: Which character marks the end of a C string?
questions.explanation: A C string is terminated by the null character '\0'.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to return a value from a function?
questions.explanation: The return statement terminates a function and can provide a value to the calling function.
